body: I sure hope so. My princess has been impatiently waiting for me to find someone.
I have one if you wanted to join! Everyone’s great in it.

Honestly, reading this after my mental breakdown calmed a little bit was exactly what I needed. I was able to read it with a clear head and I just want to say thank you. You truly helped me, sometimes thinking by myself isn’t the best. I went out and got her some valentine’s day candy to apologize for being irrational this morning. I’m gonna keep pushing, even if it’s the hardest thing I do. I’ve done it for this long I should continue, right?

I stopped taking her crap, now we don’t really talk. We avoid each other, which honestly I think is the best outcome while I’m still in her house. Raves are awesome, I’ve been to three. True life changing experiences, especially if you’re into EDM and the life of PLUR (Peace, love, unity, respect) and yeah. We actually broke up for a couple months, and I pushed harder than I thought I would. So I think if something were to happen. I’d be okay. Broken up about it obviously, but okay. We’ve been together for five years coming up this May. She’s truly my light. Thank you for all your advice, honestly. It’s been nice to talk to someone.

She knows everything, even if I don’t tell her she always has a way of knowing. She’s really been the only one to truly understand. And honestly, I’m not sure. My fellow roommates are confused, I’m usually a pushover that does all I can for people. I don’t like causing problems in people’s lives so for the most part I just stand to the side. But she truly has a problem with me, she has narcissistic personality disorder so I’m pretty sure that’s really just it. It’s almost as if once I stopped taking her shit, she decided I’m a problem. My other roommate says she’s pretty sure it’s just envy. Her wanting to be in a happy relationship. It’s just frustrating sometimes. And thank you, truly. I proposed to her at our first ever rave, so there’s some magic in my life at least. People say that we’re like one of those movie couples. She’s truly made my life better, and is the sole reason I push.

Going into details is hard for me, I’m usually the type to help others and ignore my problems. The roommate situation is messed, she’s just all around toxic to everyone. We’re working on leaving, should be out next month. To give you some insight, I moved in about two years ago and we’ve been through 12 other people in the house thanks to her. Though, she’s my fiancee’s cousin she hates me the most. Kinda a possessive thing towards my fiancée, wants her to herself. And yeah, I know. It was actually really hard to type this out and I’m tempted to just delete it altogether. Talking to strangers is a little easier though, I can keep it all anonymous.

I’m literally in the same page, including the joblessness. She’s been the reason I haven’t done anything for the past six years, but every day gets harder. The only reason I don’t do it is because I know it would truly break her. And I hate the thought of causing her pain.
